apps.localizedDescription:
Stratagus for iOS:

Warcraft II (Wargus) on iOS, running the Stratagus engine. Single-player and local-network multiplayer are playable: touch + gesture controls, on-screen keyboard, and saves visible in the Files app.

Bring your own Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition files — the app ships no game data. On first launch you get an import screen: put the files somewhere the Files app can reach (iCloud Drive, On My iPhone, or a USB drive), tap Import, and pick a folder containing either:

• Already-extracted data — a folder holding Install.mpq and the Support/ folder (e.g. extracted earlier on a PC). This skips the unpack step.

versions.localizedDescription:
Warcraft II (Wargus) on iOS — single-player and local-network multiplayer.

Install: sideload the .ipa with SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, or TrollStore. Bring your own Warcraft II data (GOG/CD) — import it on first launch. See more, including touch controls and multiplayer details in the README.

Note: LAN auto-discovery requires signing with a PAID Apple Developer account (the multicast entitlement). Free account sideloads can still play multiplayer — use "Add server" in Join Local Game to enter the host's IP manually.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Wargus uses your local network to host and find nearby multiplayer games.
